people.name: Achish
people.line: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”
translations.bsb: Now in those days the Philistines gathered their forces for warfare against Israel. So Achish said to David, “You must understand that you and your men are to go out to battle with me.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered ➔ their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their hosts together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me in the host, thou and thy men.
